messages:
maria-cs: FYI were seeing onboarding delays for tenants created during last night's EU index migration. ~15 tenants affected (12 trials, 3 high-touch). Need customer comms and localized notes.

ashley-se: Please DM tenant list and 1-line root cause. ETA on recovery?

maria-cs: Root cause: indexer backlog + aggressive provisioning retries hitting a rate-limiter. DMing list.

sam-eng: Mitigation applied: extra indexer workers + relaxed retry backoff + temporary limiter widening. Queue depth dropping, expect catch-up in 30-45m.

neil-ops: Confirmed limiter config rolled at 17:18 UTC; backfill in progress (9/15 complete).

lina-localization: Ill translate FR/DE/ES. Send final subject/body and Ill return localized versions in 20m.

incident-bot: INC-2026-042 created: "EU migration onboarding latency" Severity=S2 Owners=sam-eng,neil-ops,maria-cs

maria-cs: Draft outbound (will localize): Subject: Update: onboarding delay during EU migration — remedial steps and offer. Body: short apology, steps taken, offer 1 week credits (2 for high-touch) + office hours or prioritized import. Include feedback survey link. Will send individualized notes to high-touch accounts within 45m and bulk localized note to trials once translations are ready.
